mentions.name: Nthesis document chat
mentions.description: A web app that lets people chat with the documents in the Hacker News 'What are you working on?' post, with the indexed content updating live, and also provides a basic text search over the same documents.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a way to chat with the documents in this post (updates live).

https://nthesis.ai/public/702445eb-f0e4-4730-b34f-f34eb06dd6aa/chat

Or you can do a basic text search: https://nthesis.ai/public/hn-working-on
